justifications.strategies: R2 committed 121117 B, R2.1 131808 B (+10691 B), R2.1 re-measure 159372 B with the levered/unlevered columns. R2.2 (AI Factor restated to the sleeve basis, #624) measured 176386 B on d7d26c09 and +509 B more with the basis statements (parent-account tags on execution_cost, its EXECUTION component, the live-series summary and the provider overlap, and the execution cost in the not-restated label): 176895 B against 159372 B (+17523 B, +11.0%).
